name: Palette
long_description: Palette is an interactive multimodal generation platform that helps people create, personalize, and maintain multimedia content at scale. Instead of relying on fragmented creative tools or manual production workflows, Palette enables them to generate, edit, and transform text, images, and video using natural language. Whether creating customer experiences, product content, educational materials, or internal communications, Palette makes professional-quality media generation accessible through a single interface.
one_liner: An interactive AI video generation and editing platform
